notable_absence.finding: This page's entire 'Retrieving Replication Status Data' section (endpoints, curl requests, and both JSON response examples) is near-verbatim identical to sync-inter-syncgateway-manage.json's 'Getting Replication Status Data' section - same endpoint, same example replication IDs (db1-rep-id2, db1-rep-id1-pull, db2-rep-id1), same query-string filters, same response bodies. The only content genuinely unique to this page is the pointer to the `/_expvar` statistics endpoint and a cross-reference to manage/stats-monitoring.md. A reader following 'Monitor' expecting a distinct monitoring-specific view instead gets a duplicate of the Manage page's status section. No XDCR mention anywhere on this page either - the fourth of five ISGR-dedicated pages in this batch silent on XDCR.

cross_component_finding: No comparison to XDCR's own monitoring surface (e.g. XDCR's replication-status enum, already flagged elsewhere in the registry as xdcr:replication-status-enum with three divergent vocabularies across Capella/Web-Console/REST) appears anywhere on this page, even though it would be a natural point of comparison for a monitoring-focused page. Extraction-layer observation only, not a source statement.
